ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: avsbus_controller
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Command, readback, status, and interrupt registers for the AVSBus (V1.3.1) controller.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CMD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: The command+data to be transferred to the AVS bus

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write Cmd Data. Formats: [list] [*]Voltage (cmd_code 0x0): 16-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV [*]Transition Rate (cmd_code 0x1): [list] [*]MSByte: Rise Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [*]LSByte: Fall Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [/list] [*]Reset Voltage (cmd_code 0x4): 16-bits, all zeroes [*]Power Mode (cmd_code 0x5): 3-bits, LSB aligned: [list] [*]0x0 - Maximum Efficiency [*]0x3 - Maximum Power [*]0x4-0x7 - Manufacturer-specific [/list] [*]AVSBus Status (cmd_code 0xe): 16-bits, encoded per AVS Spec [*]AVSBus Version (cmd_code 0xf): 4 bits encoded per AVS Spec, LSB-aligned [*]For read cmd_code's, this is 0xffff [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RAIL_SEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Rail Select: 0x0 - Rail 0 0x1 - Rail 1 0xf - Broadcast

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_CODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command Code (For cmd_group=0. For cmd_group=1, this is manufacturer-specific): [list] [*]0x0 - Target Rail Voltage Read/Write [*]0x1 - Vout Transition Rate Read/Write [*]0x2 - Rail Current Read [*]0x3 - Temperature Read [*]0x4 - Force Voltage Reset (Requires wr_cmd_data=0x0) [*]0x5 - Power Mode Read/Write [*]0xe - AVSBus Status Read/Write [*]0xf - AVSBus Version Read [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_GRP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command group: Set to 1 for manufacturer-specific Command Code (cmd_code), otherwise 0

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: R_OR_W
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read or write type: [list] [*]0x0 - Commit Write [*]0x1 - Hold Write [*]0x2 - Read [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_READBACK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Response data from AVS slave device (updated in response to both AVS read and write commands). Reading this register causes the AVS response readback fifo pointer to advance.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CRC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The CRC-3 code received from slave

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Cmd Data. Format depends on cmd_code in previous master subframe:[list] [*]Voltage (cmd_code 0x0): 16-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV [*]Transition Rate (cmd_code 0x1): [list] [*]MSByte: Rise Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [*]LSByte: Fall Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [/list] [*]Current (cmd_mode 0x2): 16-bit unsigned, 1LSB=10mA [*]Temperature (cmd_code 0x3): 16-bit signed, 1LSB=0.1degC [*]Power Mode (cmd_code 0x5): 3-bits, LSB aligned: [list] [*]0x0 - Maximum Efficiency [*]0x3 - Maximum Power [*]0x4-0x7 - Manufacturer-specific [/list] [*]AVSBus Status (cmd_code 0xe): 16-bits, encoded per AVS Spec [*]AVSBus Version (cmd_code 0xf): 4 bits encoded per AVS Spec, LSB-aligned [*]If master issued a write (rw!=0x2) in previous master subframe, this field is 0xffff [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATUS_RESPONSE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 5-bit field indicating general condition of the slave, per AVS spec StatusReponse field: [list] [*]bit 4: VDone - AND of all VDone bits of active rails [*]bit 3: StatusAlert - Indicates potential status issue, requiring AVSBus Status read cmd for details [*]bit 2: AVS_Control - 1 if ABSBus is controlling at least 1 device output, 0 otherwise. [*]bit 1: MfrSpcfc_Stts1 - Manufacturer-specific [*]bit 0: MfrSpcfc_Stts2 - Manufacturer-specific [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONST0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Always 0

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SLAVE_ACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates whether command executed or not - codes 0x1 and 0x2 trigger automatic retries by hardware: [list] [*]0x0: Action Performed [*]0x1: Good CRC received but resource unavailable - hardware will retry [*]0x2: Bad CRC received - hardware will retry [*]0x3: Good CRC received but bad data, data type or selector - no hardware retry [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_DEBUG_READBACK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register mirrors the AVS_READBACK register, but reading it does NOT affect the AVS readback fifo pointer. Provided for debug purposes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The current top-of-fifo AVS slave response sub-frame in the readback fifo

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_LATEST_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register contains the most recently received subframe from the AVS slave, bypassing the AVS readback fifo. It is provided so that APB can see the current slave StatusResponse and SlaveAck settings in a timely fashion, since the status data from the next entry in the readback fifo might have considerable latency relative to when it was initially received from the AVS Slave.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The most recently received AVS slave response sub-frame

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_NORMAL_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Various Status bits indicating normal operating conditions for APB2AVS bridge block. These all have corresponding maskable bits in the AVS_INTERRUPT register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TOTAL_RETRIES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total number of retries attempted by the AVS Master

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_MASTER_IS_RETRYING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Master is currently in the middle of retrying a failed command

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is full - any additional APB writes to AVS_CMD will be dropped until the AVS bus can accept the next command, thus freeing space in the cmd fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates read-back fifo is full - no new AVS commands will be launched until space is freed by an AVS_READBACK access

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_HAS_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_READBACK register has data ready to read on APB

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_BUS_IS_IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that neither AVS master nor slave is currently driving a transaction on the AVS bus

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_IS_IN_RESYNC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the AVS master is issuing a slave resync operation (34 clock cycles of holding mdata high)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains the most recent status feedback from the AVS slave device

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_STATUS_RESPONSE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The 5-bit Slave StatusResponse of the most recent slave subframe received, indicating the general condition of the slave, per AVS spec StatusReponse field: [list] [*]bit 4: VDone - AND of all VDone bits of active rails [*]bit 3: StatusAlert - Indicates potential status issue, requiring AVSBus Status read cmd for details [*]bit 2: AVS_Control - 1 if ABSBus is controlling at least 1 device output, 0 otherwise. [*]bit 1: MfrSpcfc_Stts1 - Manufacturer-specific [*]bit 0: MfrSpcfc_Stts2 - Manufacturer-specific [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_ACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The SlaveAck bits of the most recent slave subframe received: [list] [*]00: Action Performed [*]01:Good CRC received by resource unavailable. No action performed (triggers retry) [*]10: Bad CRC received (triggers retry) [*]11: Good CRC received bit bad data, data type, or selector. No action performed [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_FIFOS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains the number of occupied and vacant slots in the AVS master's command and readback FIFOs

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_OCCUPIED_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of occupied slots in the command FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_VACANT_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of vacant slots in the command FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_OCCUPIED_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of occupied slots in the readback FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_VACANT_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of vacant slots in the readback FIFO

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt register - A '1' indicates an interrupt has occurred for that bit. To clear the interrupt bit, write to the corresponding field in the AVS_INTERRUPT_CLEAR register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the AVS slave has signaled an interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is full - any additional APB writes to AVS_CMD will be dropped until the AVS bus can accept the next command, thus freeing space in the cmd fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates read-back fifo is full - no new AVS commands will be launched until space is freed by an AVS_READBACK access

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_READBACK register has data ready to read on APB

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the AVS Slave device is not responding to command subframes from the Master

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the AVS Master failed to receive a non-failure acknowledgement from the Slave after a command was retried the maximum allowable number of times (as determined by AVS_CFG_0:max_retries)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an APB write to AVS_CMD was attempted when the the command fifo was already full - the command is dropped

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an APB read on the AVS_READBACK reg occurred when the readback fifo was empty (AVS_NORMAL_STATUS:readback_has_data=0)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the response from AVS slave could not be written to readback FIFO due to it being full => response was dropped

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT_MASK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt mask register - Determines which AVS_INTERRUPT bits can trigger an interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable notification of AVS slave interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable cmd_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_has_data interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable slave_unresponsive interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable max_retries_attempted interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable cmd_fifo_overflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_underflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_overflow interrupt

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT_CLEAR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Write 1 to clear corresponding interrupt bit

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear avs_slave_issued_interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear cmd_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_has_data interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear slave_unresponsive interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear max_retries_attempted interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear cmd_fifo_overflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_underflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_overflow interrupt

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CFG_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configuration register for APB2AVS bridge block

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESYNC_INTERVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Max interval to issue slave resync operation on AVS bus, expressed in number of APB clock cycles. NOTE: there is a 3 cycle delay for the resync flag to be seen by the avs controller due to synchronization.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_RETRIES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum number of times to attempt a retry if an AVS command returns a fail status (either due to targeted resource being busy or CRC failure)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CFG_1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configuration register for APB2AVS bridge block

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_CLOCK_SELECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects which clock to use for AVS Clock: [list] [*] 00: Use the APB clock directly as the AVS clock [*] 01: Use a divided version of APB clock as the AVS Clock. The clock divider settings are determined by AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_value and AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator [*] 10: Use the refclk clock directly as the AVS clock [*] 11: Use a divided version of refclk clock as the AVS Clock. The clock divider settings are determined by AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_value and AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP_AVS_CLOCK_ON_IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the AVS bus is idle, gate the avs_clock from running. Restart it when there are new commands to be run. The master will always first issue 34 slave-resync cycles when the clock first restarts.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FORCE_SLAVE_RESYNC_OPERATION
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Force master to issue a slave resync (34 clock cycles of holding the mdata signal high) at the next possible opportunity. NOTE: there is a 3 cycle delay for the resync flag to be seen by the avs controller due to synchronization.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TURN_OFF_ALL_PREMUX_CLOCKS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Gate off all clocks entering the AVS clock mux - do this before changing the mux selection or changing the clock divider settings, then turn back on afterwards

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLK_DIVIDER_VALUE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Determines the divisor value used to generate the AVS clock (when avs_clock_select is set to select the divided APB clock or divided refclk clock). The duty cycle of the divided clock depends both on the clk_divider_value together with the clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator value. A 50% duty cycle is only possible on even clk_divider_values with clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator set to 128. This field requires a minimum value of 2 - for lower values, 2 will be assumed. This is set to 0 by default to trick the clock divider into maintaining the HW-default settings (divider=0x4) by matching the FF default in the resynced version of the signal.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLK_DIVIDER_DUTY_CYCLE_NUMERATOR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Determines the desired duty cycle of the divided clock (when avs_clock_select is set to select the divided APB clock or refclk clock). This value will be divided by 256 to determine the high-pulse percentage of the divided clock period. Depending on the clk_divider_value, it may not be possible to precisely achieve the desired duty cycle - in that case, the closest possible fit is used. If this is set to 0, a value of 1 will be assumed. This is set to 0 by default to trick the clock divider into maintaining the HW-default settings (numerator=0x80) by matching the FF default in the resynced version of the signal.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_GPIO_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable AVSBus connection to GPIOs. The effective sets OE of the GPIOs dedicated to avs_clock and avs_cdata to 1, sets IE of GPIO dedicated to avs_tdata to 1. By default, this is enabled as the AVSBus state machine immediately starts after reset deassertion.
